blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Bacolod City has recorded its sixth dengue death of the year on Tuesday after an 8-year-old girl from Barangay Handumanan succumbed to severe complications from the mosquito-borne virus. The City Health Office said that the child passed away at a Bacolod hospital due to multiple organ dysfunction syndrome secondary to severe dengue, dengue hemorrhagic shock, pulmonary hemorrhage, and unspecified sepsis. The patient’s illness began on September 28 when she experienced intermittent high-grade fevers.
